objective: Produce one bounded implementation artifact at the exact declared path from fixed inputs and checks.

value_gate.leverage: The worker can produce one constrained artifact from fixed evidence while independent validation remains with the parent.

evidence.purpose: Fixed creator boundary for the artifact.

constraints: Write only the one exact artifact declared in write_scope.
Do not invoke another agent or modify any directory-wide scope.
Do not make policy, authority, acceptance, or retry decisions for the parent.

acceptance.observable: The one declared artifact is present and independently checkable by the parent.
